column1: # The run set of the release tests from 0.7.1 (spec docs/specs/2026-11-12-release-tests-0.7.1-spec.md, decisions R1 to R10; the 0.7.0 rows are in run_set_legacy.tsv, test data only).
# Input of tests/seasons/future/run_set.py. One row per game.
# tier: A (RECOMP_TIER_A=1, slice 3), B (the full world, with the world-health checks and the Tier B limits), world (as B
#   with no Tier B limit, which needs decades of saves; the release rows), late (as B, from the checkpoint save of the
#   Tier A row in the column from, in the year start; open item 193), weekly (as B with the test-only market
#   RECOMP_TEST_MARKET_WEEKLY=1: the AI market on Mondays only; not the shipped game), jump (a new game in a far year,
#   RECOMP_DATE_JUMP=1, the December 2025 database), normal (the full world, the checker only; the quick set that tests
# changing: changing rules on or off. nations: all, or names joined by commas. last: the last season (2100: the game
# plays the season 2100/01). leg_years: the seasons of one leg (one save and load each); a leg that ends in a new

# decade keeps its save as the checkpoint of that decade. set: release (the whole run set, Q12), quick (only with --set quick), background (plays on after the release, not in --verify). status: run, or waits (with the reason in note).
# database (release tests 0.7.1, slice 1; empty means tile): tile (the data of the start year on the start screen),
#   3.9.60, 3.9.65 or 3.9.68 (the base data, 2001 only). extras: none (empty), all (the English Conference, German
#   Regionalliga, Serie C2, Spanish Segunda B, Portuguese Second Division B and Swedish Second Division) or names
#   joined by commas. last: a season, or tile (the season before the end point of the start, Decisions R1 of the spec).
